checks.finding: HAMS SourceCode remains a hydrodynamic kernel and has not been modified by the rocket-leg work.
checks.impact: This preserves the project boundary: HAMS replaces AQWA-like potential-flow hydrodynamics, not Adams-like leg dynamics.
checks.recommended_action: Keep rocket recovery logic in external analysis modules.

checks.finding: The locally compiled HAMS executable is checked against all four official CertTest output sets.
checks.impact: A failed hydrodynamic regression limits downstream confidence even when the external Chrono chain runs.
checks.recommended_action: See docs/hams-certtest-toolchain-diagnosis.md; resolve the Intel/MKL versus GNU toolchain provenance without relaxing the registered tolerances.

checks.finding: Wang 2023 is currently a transparent HAMS/Cummins surrogate, not a pointwise AQWA/STAR-CCM+ reproduction.
checks.impact: The largest text-indicator error is too high to claim that the Wang paper result has been reproduced exactly.
checks.recommended_action: Digitize Wang Figures 6 and 8-10 or obtain original CFD/AQWA time histories; then recalibrate only with an explicit calibrated-source label.

checks.finding: Nargolkar table values are tracked, but figure-level time-history reproduction is not yet quantitatively tight.
checks.impact: The current comparison is useful for debugging and trend checks; it should not be cited as exact reproduction of Figures 9/10.
checks.recommended_action: Review Table 2 frequency/mass inconsistency, improve figure digitization, and add a strict error threshold per plotted response.

checks.finding: Chrono contact and lock reactions are mapped into a full 6DOF HAMS/Cummins incremental correction.
checks.impact: This closes the previous omission of surge, sway and yaw leg-reaction increments.
checks.recommended_action: Keep six-component force reciprocity and response-channel checks in every coupled run.

checks.finding: The Wang wave/plume baseline remains limited to heave, roll and pitch; zero surge/sway/yaw baselines are explicit placeholders, not reproduced paper data.

checks.impact: Non-negligible closure residual means the one-pass or finitely iterated platform and leg reactions remain a loose partitioned approximation.
checks.recommended_action: Use documented under-relaxation and an explicit residual gate before claiming converged two-way coupling.

checks.finding: The Chrono landing animation starts near touchdown with prescribed velocity; it is not a full rocket descent/GNC/engine-throttle simulation.
checks.impact: The animation is physically computed for contact and post-touchdown response, but not for the earlier guided descent trajectory.
checks.recommended_action: Keep the current animation label as touchdown/contact simulation; add a separate GNC/engine descent module only after propulsion and guidance data exist.

checks.finding: The Adams-equivalent geometric leg mechanism remains blocked by missing real CAD/Adams/topology data.
checks.impact: Stage 3A/3B/3C are proxies/diagnostics. They are not a full Adams-equivalent landing-leg replica.
checks.recommended_action: Fill the request-pack CSVs from CAD, Adams export, author data, or measured engineering data; then rerun importer, validator, builder and real runtime gate.

checks.finding: The nonlinear buffer branch uses Thies figure digitization, not original author tables or measured hydropneumatic data.
checks.evidence: curve_status=digitized, buffer_law=compression_only_table from Thies 2022 Figures 4 and 5 digitized curves, claim_boundary=These are digitized curves from the visible PDF figures, not original author data. They are suitable for an auditable open Chrono table-law input, not for claiming exact Adams source-data recovery.
checks.impact: This is traceable to the supplied paper, but the curve accuracy is limited by raster extraction and a numerical hard-stop guard.
checks.recommended_action: Replace the digitized Figure 4/5 curves with author tables or measured absorber curves when available.

checks.finding: The post-touchdown lock is a Chrono fixed-link proxy, not a published clamp or seafastening mechanism.
checks.evidence: ["This is loose linear correction, not monolithic strong co-simulation.", "The final replay synchronizes animation and deck history, but its returned reactions are only reported as the next-pass closure diagnostic; fixed-point convergence is not claimed.", "Wang 2023 supplies only the heave/roll/pitch wave-plume baseline; surge/sway/yaw baseline values are zero, not paper-reproduced responses.", "No unpublished mooring or DP horizontal restoring data are synthesized; surge/sway/yaw increments are unmoored diagnostics driven by Chrono reactions and HAMS radiation.", "The lock is a ChLinkMateFix proxy, not a published clamp hardware model."]
checks.impact: It is useful for stabilizing and feeding back reactions, but it is not validated hardware.
checks.recommended_action: Replace with real lock geometry, timing, stiffness and actuator data if the recovery-after-touchdown phase becomes a target result.

checks.finding: The literature registry is explicit, but several paper curves are still missing for point-by-point validation.
checks.impact: The reports should be read as traceable reproduction attempts plus registered gaps, not as complete paper replication.
checks.recommended_action: Digitize or obtain the listed Wang, Thies, Yue and Li curves before using them as strict validation plots.

checks.finding: Assumptions and non-claims are machine-readable in the active coupled report.
checks.impact: This prevents proxy parameters from being silently promoted into reproduced paper data.
checks.recommended_action: Keep every new parameter tagged as paper/computed/calibrated/assumption/to_verify.

gaps.finding: The locally compiled HAMS executable is checked against all four official CertTest output sets.
gaps.impact: A failed hydrodynamic regression limits downstream confidence even when the external Chrono chain runs.
gaps.recommended_action: See docs/hams-certtest-toolchain-diagnosis.md; resolve the Intel/MKL versus GNU toolchain provenance without relaxing the registered tolerances.

gaps.finding: Wang 2023 is currently a transparent HAMS/Cummins surrogate, not a pointwise AQWA/STAR-CCM+ reproduction.
gaps.impact: The largest text-indicator error is too high to claim that the Wang paper result has been reproduced exactly.
gaps.recommended_action: Digitize Wang Figures 6 and 8-10 or obtain original CFD/AQWA time histories; then recalibrate only with an explicit calibrated-source label.

gaps.finding: Nargolkar table values are tracked, but figure-level time-history reproduction is not yet quantitatively tight.
gaps.impact: The current comparison is useful for debugging and trend checks; it should not be cited as exact reproduction of Figures 9/10.
gaps.recommended_action: Review Table 2 frequency/mass inconsistency, improve figure digitization, and add a strict error threshold per plotted response.

gaps.finding: The Wang wave/plume baseline remains limited to heave, roll and pitch; zero surge/sway/yaw baselines are explicit placeholders, not reproduced paper data.

gaps.finding: The Chrono landing animation starts near touchdown with prescribed velocity; it is not a full rocket descent/GNC/engine-throttle simulation.
gaps.impact: The animation is physically computed for contact and post-touchdown response, but not for the earlier guided descent trajectory.
gaps.recommended_action: Keep the current animation label as touchdown/contact simulation; add a separate GNC/engine descent module only after propulsion and guidance data exist.
